test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four items connected with computers are listed, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is-

 
• Hard disk- It is a storage device
 
• CD- It is a storage device.
 
• Flash Drive- It is a storage device.
 
• ***Monitor- It is an output device but not a storage device***.

Hence, **'option 4' **is the correct answer.

 
• Definition of storage device - A hardware device that can be used to store digital data and applications which may be in the form of images, video, audio, etc. is called a storage device.
